_comment: External checkouts are never vendored. CI fetches pinned revisions;
local analysis uses existing checkouts without changing or fetching them.
Kanon owns policy; Anoieu implements the checker pinned in scripts/deps.lock.
scripts/bump_anoieu moves that pin after checking this repository.
Koine and cvc5 use the dedicated lock files named below. A normal local
cvc5 analysis records the actual revision and content it read; the cvc5
lock identifies the reproducible baseline used in CI.
